body:
Our order sync is failing; every call to /v2/orders returns 502 Bad Gateway.

Ben Foster
IT, Northwind Traders
Hi Ben, a load balancer in eu-west was misconfigured; it's fixed and your sync has caught up.

The patient portal can't reach your API this morning, we're getting 502s on every request.

Dr. Amara Osei
CMIO, Northwind Health
Hi Dr. Osei, this was caused by an expired certificate on our side (INC-4390). It was renewed and the API is healthy again.

It's happening again: since about 12:30 UTC every patient portal API call returns 502. Front desks can't check patients in.

Dr. Amara Osei
CMIO, Northwind Health

Hi Dr. Osei, thanks for letting us know. We're looking into it now and will update you shortly.

Rita

Our AP team can't process the October invoice without PO 77-1042 on it. Can you reissue it?

Kenji Watanabe
Accounts Payable, Northwind Health

Your webhook deliveries to our endpoint keep retrying; the delivery log shows 502 from our proxy.

Fatima Al-Sayed
Cedar Pharmacy
Hi Fatima, the 502 is coming from your reverse proxy, not from us. Could you check its upstream timeout?
